import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static long calc(long n) {
        if (n == 0) return 0;
        long k = 0, amt = 0;
        while (k * 10 + 1 <= n) {
            k = k * 10 + 1;
            ++amt;
        }
        long res1 = amt * (n / k) + calc(n % k);
        long res2 = amt + 1;
        n = 10 * k + 1 - n;
        res2 += amt * (n / k) + calc(n % k);
        return Math.min(res1, res2);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try {
            // For online judges, use System.in and System.out
            // For local testing, you can redirect input/output
            Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
            long n = scanner.nextLong();
            System.out.println(calc(n));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // Handle any exceptions gracefully
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}
